basis.observed_title: FEM: profile remaining large coupled accounting export validation cost

assessment: The bead requires profiling and identifying safe bounded reuse opportunities; optimization implementation is not an unconditional deliverable.
required_profiling_deliverables: Complete and retain an actual whole accepted public export profile on the frozen public132-bay fixture representation, with honest runtime/source/input identities, call counts, wall/process CPU scope and profiling-overhead caveats.

Attribute the material remaining operation-local CAD/mesh/ownership validation costs using the observed profile. Do not derive a cause by subtracting overlapping log labels or treat the preserved setup halt as reproduction.

Identify evidence-supported bounded reuse opportunities and their dependencies, lifetime, guard obligations and stale-state risks. If none is justified, report that limitation explicitly rather than inventing a fix or speedup.

Preserve the full fixture and existing guards, public types/native IDs and source/app custody during profiling. Retain the approved restored-ID amendment and never claim old solve qualification transfers to a new export.
Keep profile-only, historical physical, future candidate and engineering claims separate, with no Oomakhi solve, changed acceptance limits or installation.
conditional_on_product_implementation: Before code changes, derive a short red-capable regression or deterministic repeated-work/coverage bound from the observed hot path.
Require attributable work reduction and a strict same-input baseline/candidate whole-call comparison before claiming an improvement; no arbitrary SLA or leaf-only substitute.

Require exact native/public output parity and the relevant operation-lifetime, exception/direct-write, edit/remesh/reorder, ownership/rank/domain, capacity and backward-compatibility regression gates.

Require fresh full132 physical qualification with all3566 original checks, separate cold history and early2112 refusal at unchanged limits before accepting a product candidate. Run appropriate source/build quality gates for the actual changed scope.

existing_plan_clarification.overbroad_sentence: The plan's unconditional wording that completion requires a meaningful matched whole-call improvement belongs to prospective optimization acceptance, not to the profiling-only bead.
existing_plan_clarification.fresh_physics_clarification: Fresh132/cold/refusal gates described in earlier plans and the restored-input amendment are product-candidate acceptance obligations, not a requirement to solve an unchanged profiling-only case.
existing_plan_clarification.bead_notes: The notes say implementation occurs only if justified and refer to fresh physical gates for a candidate. Those self-recorded plans do not convert the title/description into an unconditional optimization task.

not_required_for_profiling_only: A product optimization patch or demonstrated speedup.
A matched candidate timing run when no candidate exists.
A fresh native solve, full physical regression, application rebuild or installation solely to certify unchanged profiling code.

limits.completion_verdict: Deferred until the actual completed profile and evidence-backed cost/opportunity analysis are available.
limits.reviewer_correction: This explicitly narrows the reviewer's earlier acceptance-plan wording; it does not relax any engineering acceptance limit or authorize a new action.
